comments.author: @GlobalRealLife-TV
comments.text: Billions in casino revenue, luxury spheres, and record tourism while thousands live in storm drains. The contrast in this city is heartbreaking.

replies.author: @GlobalLifeInsights
replies.text: It truly is a heartbreaking divide between dazzling neon and cold shadows. Did you know about this subterranean world before watching, or did it completely surprise you?
